en.question: What must be done if it has not been established who the skipper is before the voyage begins?
answers: The responsible skipper must be designated.
The responsible skipper must be elected.
A holder of a recreational craft licence must take over the helm.
A holder of a recreational craft licence must assume responsibility.

explanation.de: Vor Antritt der Fahrt muss eindeutig festgelegt (bestimmt) werden, wer der verantwortliche Schiffsführer ist. Eine Wahl (Antwort b) impliziert ein demokratisches Verfahren, das rechtlich nicht vorgesehen ist — die Bestimmung erfolgt durch Benennung, nicht durch Abstimmung.
explanation.en: Before departure, it must be clearly designated (not voted on) who the responsible skipper is. Option (b) is wrong because 'elected' implies a democratic vote, which is not the legally prescribed process — the skipper is appointed/designated, not chosen by majority.
explanation.memoryAid: Designate, don't vote — the skipper is appointed, not elected.

en.question: In which cases is it prohibited to operate a recreational vessel or independently determine its course or speed?
answers: When one is impaired in the safe operation of the vessel as a result of physical or mental deficiencies or as a result of the consumption of alcoholic beverages or other intoxicating substances, or when a blood alcohol concentration of 0.5‰ or more is present in the body.

When one is impaired in the safe operation of the vessel as a result of physical or mental deficiencies or as a result of the consumption of alcoholic beverages or other intoxicating substances, or when a blood alcohol concentration of 0.8‰ or more is present in the body.

When one is impaired in the safe operation of the vessel as a result of physical or mental deficiencies or as a result of the consumption of alcoholic beverages or other intoxicating substances, or when a blood alcohol concentration of 1.0‰ or more is present in the body.

When one is impaired in the safe operation of the vessel as a result of physical or mental deficiencies or as a result of the consumption of alcoholic beverages or other intoxicating substances, or when a blood alcohol concentration of 0.3‰ or more is present in the body.

explanation.de: Nach der Seeschifffahrtsstraßen-Ordnung (SeeSchStrO) gilt für das Führen eines Sportboots eine Blutalkoholgrenze von 0,5 ‰. Darüber hinaus ist das Führen auch unterhalb dieses Wertes verboten, wenn eine körperliche, geistige oder stoffbedingte Beeinträchtigung vorliegt. Die anderen Grenzwerte (0,8 ‰, 1,0 ‰, 0,3 ‰) sind falsch.
explanation.en: Under German maritime regulations (Seeschifffahrtsstraßen-Ordnung), the legal blood alcohol limit for operating a recreational vessel is 0.5‰ — the same threshold as for road vehicles. Operating a vessel is also prohibited regardless of BAC if physical, mental, or substance-related impairment is present. The distractors (0.8‰, 1.0‰, 0.3‰) are all incorrect thresholds.
explanation.memoryAid: 0.5‰ on sea = same as on street — half a per-mille, half the fun, all the responsibility.

en.question: When is a vessel underway?
answers: When it is neither at anchor, nor made fast to the shore, nor aground.
When it is neither at anchor, nor made fast to the shore, nor making way over the ground.
When it is neither aground, nor at anchor, nor restricted in its ability to manoeuvre, nor unable to manoeuvre.
When it is neither made fast to the shore, nor at anchor, nor making way through the water.

explanation.de: Gemäß Regel 3(i) KVR ist ein Fahrzeug 'in Fahrt', wenn es weder vor Anker liegt, noch an Land festgemacht ist, noch auf Grund sitzt – unabhängig davon, ob es sich tatsächlich bewegt. Die Antworten (b) und (d) fügen fälschlicherweise eine Fahrtbedingung hinzu, während (c) den Manövrierstatus als Kriterium nennt, was nicht der Definition entspricht.
explanation.en: Under COLREG Rule 3(i), a vessel is 'underway' when it is not at anchor, not made fast to the shore, and not aground — regardless of whether it is actually moving. Options (b) and (d) incorrectly add a movement condition ('making way'), while option (c) incorrectly introduces manoeuvring status as a criterion.
explanation.memoryAid: 'Underway' = not anchored, not moored, not aground — movement is irrelevant.

en.question: What is the duration of a short blast ( )?
answers: Approximately 1 second.
Approximately 2 seconds.
Less than 1 second.
Less than 4 seconds.

explanation.de: Laut KVR (COLREG) Regel 32 dauert ein kurzer Ton etwa 1 Sekunde. Ein langer Ton dauert dagegen 4–6 Sekunden. 'Weniger als 1 Sekunde' wäre zu kurz und 'weniger als 4 Sekunden' zu ungenau.
explanation.en: Under COLREG Rule 32, a short blast has a duration of approximately 1 second. A prolonged blast lasts 4–6 seconds. 'Less than 1 second' would be too short, and 'less than 4 seconds' is imprecise and could encompass both short and prolonged blasts.
explanation.memoryAid: Short = 1 second; Prolonged = 4–6 seconds.

en.question: How long is the duration of a prolonged blast?
answers: Approximately 4 – 6 seconds.
Approximately 2 – 6 seconds.
Approximately 1 – 2 seconds.
Approximately 6 – 8 seconds.

explanation.de: Laut KVR dauert ein langer Ton 4 bis 6 Sekunden. Ein kurzer Ton dauert hingegen etwa 1 Sekunde — Antwort c beschreibt also einen kurzen Ton, nicht einen langen.
explanation.en: According to the COLREGs, a prolonged blast is defined as a blast of 4 to 6 seconds duration. A short blast, by contrast, lasts about 1 second — making option c the description of a short blast, not a prolonged one.
explanation.memoryAid: 4–6: think 'four to six for the long one' — short blasts are ~1 second, prolonged blasts are 4–6.

en.question: When is a sailing vessel considered a power-driven vessel?
answers: When it is simultaneously propelled by engine power.
When it is equipped with a propulsion engine.
When it makes no way through the water under sail.
When it makes no way over the ground under sail.

explanation.de: Ein Segelfahrzeug gilt nach den Kollisionsverhütungsregeln (KVR) als Maschinenfahrzeug, sobald es seinen Motor einsetzt – auch wenn die Segel noch gesetzt sind. Es kommt allein darauf an, ob Maschinenkraft genutzt wird, nicht darauf, ob ein Motor vorhanden ist (Antwort b) oder ob Fahrt durchs Wasser bzw. über Grund gemacht wird (Antworten c und d).
explanation.en: Under the COLREGs, a sailing vessel is classified as a power-driven vessel the moment it uses its engine — even if the sails remain set. What matters is whether engine power is being used, not merely whether an engine is fitted (answer b) or whether the vessel is actually moving through the water or over the ground (answers c and d).
explanation.memoryAid: Engine ON = power-driven, no matter how full the sails are.

en.question: What additional day signal does a vessel under sail that is considered a power-driven vessel display?
answers: A black cone, apex downwards.
A black cone, apex upwards.
A black diamond shape.
Two black balls in a vertical line.

explanation.de: Nach Regel 25(b) KVR muss ein Segelfahrzeug, das gleichzeitig seinen Motor benutzt (und damit als Maschinenfahrzeug gilt), tagsüber einen schwarzen Kegel mit der Spitze nach unten im vorderen Teil führen. Dies unterscheidet es von einem reinen Segelfahrzeug. Ein Kegel mit Spitze nach oben oder andere Formen gehören zu anderen Signalen (z. B. Ankern, manövrierunfähiges Fahrzeug).
explanation.en: Under COLREG Rule 25(b), a sailing vessel that is also using its engine (and therefore counts as a power-driven vessel) must display a black cone, apex downwards, in the forward part of the vessel. This distinguishes it from a pure sailing vessel. The apex-upwards cone and the other shapes are used for different purposes (e.g. anchoring, vessel not under command).
explanation.memoryAid: Sailing with engine = cone pointing DOWN — the motor pulls the apex toward the water.

en.question: Which side is referred to as the windward side?
answers: The side facing the wind.
The side facing away from the wind.
The side to the right in the direction of travel.
The side to the left in the direction of travel.

explanation.de: Die Luvseite ist die dem Wind zugewandte Seite eines Schiffes oder einer Küste. Das Gegenteil ist die Leeseite (die dem Wind abgewandte Seite). Die Antworten c und d beschreiben Steuerbord bzw. Backbord, die unabhängig vom Wind sind.
explanation.en: The windward side (Luv) is the side of a vessel or coastline that faces into the wind. Its opposite is the leeward side (Lee), which faces away from the wind. Options c and d describe starboard and port respectively, which are defined by the vessel's heading, not the wind direction.
explanation.memoryAid: Luv = 'Loves the wind' — it faces directly into it.

en.question: Which side is referred to as the leeward side?
answers: The side facing away from the wind.
The side facing into the wind.
The side to the right in the direction of travel.
The side to the left in the direction of travel.

explanation.de: Die Leeseite ist die dem Wind abgewandte Seite eines Schiffes oder einer Küste. Das Gegenteil ist die Luvseite (die dem Wind zugewandte Seite). Rechts und links in Fahrtrichtung beschreiben Steuerbord und Backbord, nicht Luv und Lee.
explanation.en: The leeward side is the side of a vessel or landmass that faces away from the wind. Its opposite is the windward side (luv), which faces into the wind. Starboard and port describe right and left relative to the direction of travel, which is unrelated to wind direction.
explanation.memoryAid: Lee = sheltered, away from the breeze — think 'Lee' as a calm, sheltered name.

en.question: When must vessels display their lights?
answers: From sunset to sunrise and in restricted visibility.
From sunrise to sunset and in restricted visibility.
From 18:00 in the evening to 06:00 in the morning and in restricted visibility.
In darkness, bad weather, and restricted visibility.

explanation.de: Gemäß KVR Regel 20 müssen Fahrzeuge ihre Lichter von Sonnenuntergang bis Sonnenaufgang sowie bei verminderter Sicht führen. Feste Uhrzeiten (z. B. 18:00–06:00 Uhr) gelten nicht, da Sonnenuntergang und -aufgang je nach Jahreszeit und Ort variieren. 'Dunkelheit' allein ist kein ausreichendes Kriterium — maßgeblich ist die Stellung der Sonne und die Sichtweite.
explanation.en: COLREG Rule 20 requires vessels to display lights from sunset to sunrise and during any period of restricted visibility. Fixed clock times (like 18:00–06:00) do not apply, as sunset and sunrise vary by season and location. 'Darkness' alone is not the trigger — the rule is specifically tied to the sun's position and visibility conditions.
explanation.memoryAid: Lights follow the SUN, not the CLOCK: sunset to sunrise, plus fog.

en.question: What is the purpose of navigation lights?
answers: They indicate the direction of travel and the aspect (orientation) of a vessel.
They indicate the course and speed of a vessel.
They indicate the direction of travel and the position of a vessel.
They indicate the direction of travel and the course of a vessel.

explanation.de: Die Lichterführung zeigt anderen Verkehrsteilnehmern, in welche Richtung sich ein Fahrzeug bewegt (Fahrtrichtung) und wie es zu ihnen ausgerichtet ist (Lage). Die Lage beschreibt, ob man das Fahrzeug von vorne, achtern oder von der Seite sieht – nicht dessen GPS-Position oder exakten Kurs.
explanation.en: Navigation lights show other vessels the direction of travel and the aspect (orientation) of the vessel — i.e. whether you are seeing it from ahead, astern, or the side. They do not directly indicate GPS position (option c) or a precise compass course (options b and d).
explanation.memoryAid: Lights show WHERE it's going and HOW it's facing — direction + aspect.

en.question: What type of lantern may a sailing vessel of less than 20 m in length carry instead of sidelights and a sternlight?
answers: A tricolour lantern at or near the masthead.
A bicolour lantern at a well-visible position.
A tricolour lantern at a well-visible position.
A bicolour lantern at or near the masthead.

explanation.de: Nach KVR Regel 25(b) darf ein Segelfahrzeug unter 20 m die Seitenlichter und das Hecklicht in einer einzigen Dreifarbenlaterne zusammenfassen, die jedoch an oder nahe der Mastspitze geführt werden muss, um eine ausreichende Sichtbarkeit zu gewährleisten. Eine Zweifarbenlaterne erfüllt die Anforderung nicht, da sie keinen weißen Hecksektor hat, und eine Dreifarbenlaterne an einer niedrigeren Position ist nicht zulässig.
explanation.en: Under COLREG Rule 25(b), a sailing vessel under 20 m may combine her sidelights and sternlight into a single tricolour lantern, but it must be placed at or near the masthead to ensure maximum visibility. A bicolour lantern (red/green only, no white stern sector) does not satisfy the requirement, and a tricolour at a lower position is not permitted.
explanation.memoryAid: Three colours, top of the mast — tri at the top, that's all you need.

en.question: What lights must a vessel under sail that is simultaneously propelled by machinery display?
answers: The lights prescribed for a power-driven vessel.
The lights prescribed for a sailing vessel.
Two red all-round lights arranged vertically.
Red and green sidelights and one red all-round light.

explanation.de: Ein Fahrzeug, das Segel setzt und gleichzeitig Maschinenantrieb nutzt, gilt nach KVR (COLREG) Regel 25(e) als Maschinenfahrzeug und muss dessen Lichter führen – zusätzlich kann es einen Kegel mit der Spitze nach unten im Vorschiff setzen. Die Antwort 'b' wäre nur korrekt, wenn ausschließlich gesegelt wird.
explanation.en: A vessel using both sails and engine is classified as a power-driven vessel under COLREG Rule 25(e) and must therefore display the lights required for a power-driven vessel. It may additionally show a cone apex-downwards forward. Answer 'b' would only apply if the vessel were sailing without engine power.
explanation.memoryAid: Engine on = power vessel — sails alone don't count once the motor runs.

en.question: How do two motorboats manoeuvre when approaching each other on opposite courses?
answers: Each vessel must alter course to starboard.
Each vessel must alter course to port.
The windward vessel must give way to the leeward vessel.
The leeward vessel must give way to the windward vessel.

explanation.de: Gemäß KVR Regel 14 (Kurse entgegengesetzt oder fast entgegengesetzt) muss jedes Maschinenfahrzeug seinen Kurs nach Steuerbord ändern, sodass beide Fahrzeuge an Backbord aneinander vorbeifahren. Eine Kursänderung nach Backbord (Antwort b) würde die Kollisionsgefahr erhöhen. Antworten c und d betreffen die Ausweichregeln für Segelfahrzeuge und sind hier nicht anwendbar.
explanation.en: Under COLREG Rule 14 (head-on situation), when two power-driven vessels meet on reciprocal or nearly reciprocal courses, each must alter course to starboard so they pass port-to-port. Altering to port (answer b) would cause a collision risk. Answers c and d refer to sailing vessel rules, which do not apply here.
explanation.memoryAid: Head-on: both go right — starboard keeps ships apart at night.

en.question: Two motorboats are approaching on crossing courses. There is a risk of collision. Which vessel is required to give way?
answers: The vessel that has the other on her starboard side must give way.
The vessel that has the other on her port side must give way.
The vessel to windward must give way to the vessel to leeward.
The vessel to leeward must give way to the vessel to windward.

explanation.de: Bei kreuzenden Kursen von Maschinenfahrzeugen gilt: Das Fahrzeug, das das andere an seiner Steuerbordseite hat, ist ausweichpflichtig (COLREG Regel 15). Die Antworten c und d beziehen sich auf die Luv-/Lee-Regel, die nur für Segelfahrzeuge gilt.
explanation.en: For power-driven vessels on crossing courses, the vessel that has the other on her starboard side is the give-way vessel (COLREG Rule 15). Answer options c and d refer to the windward/leeward rule, which applies only to sailing vessels.
explanation.memoryAid: Starboard = Stop and give way — if they're on your starboard side, it's your duty to yield.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sound signal?
answers: Keep-away signal: leave the danger zone immediately.
General danger and warning signal.
Vessel at anchor, over 100 m in length.
Restricted-in-ability-to-manoeuvre tow exceeding 200 m in length.

explanation.de: Das Bleib-weg-Signal besteht aus einer Folge von wiederholten Tönen (oft beschrieben als ein Dauerton oder eine festgelegte Kombination) und wird ausgestrahlt, wenn eine unmittelbare Gefahr besteht und andere Fahrzeuge den Bereich sofort räumen sollen. Es ist ein spezifisches Notwarnsignal nach der Seeschifffahrtsstraßen-Ordnung (SeeSchStrO), das nicht mit dem allgemeinen Gefahrensignal (fünf kurze Töne nach KVR) verwechselt werden darf.
explanation.en: The 'Bleib-weg-Signal' (keep-away signal) is broadcast when an immediate danger exists and all vessels must clear the area at once. It is a specific emergency warning signal under the German Seeschifffahrtsstraßen-Ordnung (SeeSchStrO) and must not be confused with the general danger/warning signal under COLREGs (five or more short blasts).
explanation.memoryAid: Bleib weg = Stay away — when you hear it, leave immediately, no questions asked.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: Overtaking prohibited.
Meeting prohibited.
Overtaking prohibited for vessels under 20 m in length.
Meeting prohibited for vessels over 20 m in length.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen mit zwei übereinanderliegenden, in dieselbe Richtung weisenden Pfeilen bedeutet ein allgemeines Überholverbot für alle Fahrzeuge, unabhängig von ihrer Länge. Ein Begegnungsverbot (Antworten b und d) wird durch ein anderes Zeichen dargestellt.
explanation.en: The board sign showing two arrows pointing in the same direction (one above the other) indicates a general prohibition on overtaking, applying to all vessels regardless of length. A meeting prohibition (answers b and d) is indicated by a different sign.
explanation.memoryAid: Two arrows going the same way = no following too closely — overtaking banned!

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sign?
answers: No meeting at a narrow section.
No meeting for vessels over 12 m in length.
No overtaking; oncoming traffic must be expected.
No overtaking for all vessels.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen bedeutet Begegnungsverbot an einer Engstelle: Fahrzeuge dürfen sich in diesem Bereich nicht begegnen. Überholen und Längenangaben sind hier nicht relevant – die Einschränkung gilt für das Begegnen aller Fahrzeuge, aber nur an der bezeichneten Engstelle.
explanation.en: The sign indicates a prohibition on meeting (passing in opposite directions) at a narrow section: vessels may not pass each other in this area. Overtaking rules and length restrictions are not relevant here — the restriction applies to all vessels meeting at that specific narrow passage.
explanation.memoryAid: Narrow = No meeting: two vessels cannot fit side by side at this bottleneck.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sign?
answers: Avoid wash and wave action.
Endangered beach area, risk of flooding; minimum passing distance 100 m.
Waterway that can be navigated safely at all times; no danger from swell.
Waterway that cannot always be navigated safely; danger from swell.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen 'Sog und Wellenschlag vermeiden' weist Bootsführer an, ihre Geschwindigkeit so zu reduzieren, dass kein schädlicher Sog oder Wellenschlag entsteht – besonders zum Schutz von Anliegern, kleineren Booten und Uferbereichen. Die anderen Antworten beschreiben andere Zeichen oder Gefahrenhinweise, die mit diesem Zeichen nichts zu tun haben.
explanation.en: The sign 'Avoid wash and wave action' instructs boat operators to reduce their speed so that no harmful wash or wave action is created — particularly to protect moored vessels, smaller boats, and shoreline areas. The other answer options describe different signs or hazard warnings unrelated to this sign.
explanation.memoryAid: Waves hurt neighbours — slow down and show you care.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: Minimum distance in metres that must be maintained in the subsequent stretch from the point where the sign is erected.
Maximum speed in km/h that must not be exceeded on the right-hand side of the fairway in the direction of travel.
Maximum distance in metres that must be maintained in the subsequent stretch from the point where the sign is erected.
Narrowing of the fairway to 40 m.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen gibt einen Mindestabstand in Metern an, der ab dem Aufstellungsort auf der folgenden Strecke eingehalten werden muss – also den geringsten Sicherheitsabstand zwischen Fahrzeugen. Es handelt sich nicht um eine Geschwindigkeit (Antwort b) und nicht um einen Maximalabstand (Antwort c), denn das Zeichen schreibt eine Untergrenze vor.
explanation.en: The board sign indicates a minimum distance in metres that must be kept from the point of erection onward — i.e. the least permitted separation between vessels. It does not denote a speed limit (answer b) nor a maximum distance (answer c), because the sign prescribes a lower bound, not an upper one.
explanation.memoryAid: A number with a distance symbol = 'at LEAST this far apart' — minimum, not maximum.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: Mandatory stop before movable bridges, surge barriers, and locks.
Permanent closure of a section of the waterway.
Requirement to sound one prolonged blast.
Recreational craft prohibited from proceeding.

explanation.de: Dieses Tafelzeichen (ein rotes Schild mit weißem Querbalken, ähnlich einem Stoppschild) bedeutet, dass Fahrzeuge vor beweglichen Brücken, Sperrwerken und Schleusen anhalten müssen, bis die Durchfahrt freigegeben wird. Es handelt sich nicht um eine dauerhafte Sperrung (b) und auch nicht um ein Schallzeichen (c) oder ein reines Verbot für Sportfahrzeuge (d).
explanation.en: This board sign (a red sign with a white horizontal bar, similar to a stop sign) requires vessels to stop before movable bridges, surge barriers, and locks until passage is authorised. It does not indicate a permanent closure (b), a requirement to sound a signal (c), or a restriction limited to recreational craft only (d).
explanation.memoryAid: Red board with white bar = STOP and wait — the waterway gate is closed until signalled open.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sign?
answers: Anchoring prohibited for all vessels.
Anchoring prohibited for small craft under 12 m in length.
Anchoring prohibited for small craft of 12 m or more in length.
Anchoring and mooring prohibited.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen 'Ankern verboten' (ein Anker mit rotem Schrägstrich) gilt für alle Fahrzeuge ohne Ausnahme. Es verbietet ausschließlich das Ankern – Festmachen ist davon nicht erfasst, was Antwort d ausschließt. Einschränkungen auf bestimmte Fahrzeuggrößen gibt es bei diesem Zeichen nicht.
explanation.en: The 'no anchoring' sign (an anchor symbol with a red diagonal bar) applies to all vessels without exception. It prohibits anchoring only — mooring is not included, which rules out answer d. There are no size-based exemptions associated with this sign.
explanation.memoryAid: A crossed-out anchor = NO anchor for ANYone.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sign?
answers: Mooring and berthing prohibited.
Mooring and berthing prohibited for recreational craft.
Mooring and berthing prohibited for recreational craft over 12 m in length.
Mooring and berthing prohibited for commercial vessels.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen gilt als allgemeines Verbot ohne Einschränkung auf eine bestimmte Fahrzeugkategorie – es verbietet das Festmachen und Liegen für alle Fahrzeuge. Die anderen Antworten schränken das Verbot fälschlicherweise auf Sportboote oder gewerbliche Schiffe ein.
explanation.en: The sign applies as a general prohibition without restriction to any particular category of vessel – it prohibits mooring and berthing for all vessels. The other answers incorrectly limit the prohibition to recreational craft or commercial vessels only.
explanation.memoryAid: No category symbol = no exceptions: the ban applies to everyone.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: Sound one prolonged blast.
Sound one short blast.
Sound two prolonged blasts.
Sound one short blast followed by one prolonged blast.

explanation.de: Das Tafelzeichen mit einem langen waagerechten Strich steht für einen langen Ton (Dauerton von ca. 4–6 Sekunden). Ein kurzer Ton wird durch einen Punkt dargestellt, nicht durch einen Strich.
explanation.en: The board sign showing one long horizontal dash represents one prolonged blast (approximately 4–6 seconds). A short blast is represented by a dot, not a dash, so the other options are incorrect.
explanation.memoryAid: Dash = prolonged blast, dot = short blast — just like Morse code.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following sign?
answers: Water areas on which water-skiing or personal watercraft (jet skis) are permitted.
A training area requiring official approval for water-skiing or personal watercraft.
Water-skiing or personal watercraft permitted. Water-skiers and personal watercraft have right of way.
A training area not requiring official approval for water-skiing or personal watercraft.

explanation.de: Dieses Tafelzeichen kennzeichnet Wasserflächen, auf denen Wasserski und Wassermotorräder (Jet-Skis) ausdrücklich erlaubt sind. Es handelt sich um ein Erlaubniszeichen, nicht um eine genehmigungs- oder trainingsrelevante Zone. Optionen b und d beschreiben fälschlicherweise eine Übungsstrecke; Option c erfindet eine Vorfahrtsregel für Wasserskiläufer.
explanation.en: This sign designates areas where water-skiing and personal watercraft (Wassermotorräder) are specifically permitted. It is a positive permission sign, not a conditional or training-zone designation. Options b and d incorrectly describe it as a training route, and option c incorrectly assigns right-of-way priority to water-skiers and personal watercraft.
explanation.memoryAid: The sign says YES to water-skiing — no approval needed, no special priority, just permission.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: End of a mandatory or prohibited section.
Section designated for a non-free-running ferry.
Crossing the fairway is permitted.
Changing sides of the fairway is permitted.

explanation.de: Dieses Tafelzeichen kennzeichnet das Ende einer Strecke, in der ein bestimmtes Gebot oder Verbot galt — es hebt die vorherige Regelung auf. Die anderen Antworten beschreiben jeweils eigene, unterschiedliche Zeichen: Fährabschnitte, Queren des Fahrwassers und Seitenwechsel sind durch gesonderte Zeichen geregelt.
explanation.en: This sign marks the end of a stretch where a specific rule (obligation or prohibition) was in force — it cancels the preceding order. The other options describe different signs: ferry sections, fairway crossing, and side-changing permissions are each indicated by their own distinct symbols.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following board sign?
answers: Prohibition of passage and closure of navigation.
Prohibition of passage and closure for small craft.
Prohibition of passage, however navigable for small craft without a running engine.
Prohibition of passage, however navigable for small craft without an engine.

explanation.de: Dieses Zeichen (weißes Schild mit rotem Rand und rotem Diagonalkreuz) bedeutet ein vollständiges Durchfahrtsverbot und die Sperrung der Schifffahrt für alle Fahrzeuge. Im Gegensatz zu Zeichen, die nur bestimmte Fahrzeugtypen beschränken, gilt dieses Zeichen ausnahmslos — keine Ausnahmen für Kleinfahrzeuge, Segelfahrzeuge oder antriebslose Fahrzeuge.
explanation.en: This sign (a white board with a red border and red diagonal cross) means a complete prohibition of passage and total closure of the waterway for all vessels. Unlike signs that only restrict certain vessel types (e.g. small craft or motorised craft), this sign applies universally — no exceptions for small craft, sailing vessels, or unpowered craft.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following waterway signs?
answers: Bridge, barrage, or lock closed.
Facility permanently closed.
Stop signal for all vessels.
Exceptional navigational obstruction.

explanation.de: Das gezeigte Zeichen (drei rote Lichter oder rote Signaltafeln übereinander) bedeutet, dass eine Brücke, ein Sperrwerk oder eine Schleuse geschlossen ist und nicht passiert werden darf. Es ist kein allgemeines Stoppsignal und bedeutet keine dauerhafte Sperrung, sondern eine vorübergehende Schließung der jeweiligen Anlage.
explanation.en: The sign shown (three red lights or red signal panels displayed vertically) indicates that a bridge, barrage, or lock is closed and must not be passed. It does not mean a permanent closure or a general stop signal for all vessels — it specifically refers to the temporary closure of that particular structure.
explanation.memoryAid: Three reds stacked = structure blocked — like a red traffic light, but for bridges and locks.

en.question: What is the meaning of the following navigation signs?
answers: Installation permanently closed.
Bridge, storm surge barrier, or lock closed.
Stop signal for all vessels.
Extraordinary obstruction to navigation.

explanation.de: Dieses Schifffahrtszeichen bedeutet, dass eine Anlage (z. B. ein Hafen oder eine Einfahrt) dauerhaft gesperrt ist. Es handelt sich nicht um ein temporäres Schließungssignal (wie bei Brücken oder Schleusen) und auch nicht um ein Stoppsignal oder eine vorübergehende Behinderung.
explanation.en: This navigation sign indicates that an installation (e.g. a harbour or entrance) is permanently closed. It is not a temporary closure signal (as used for bridges or locks), nor a stop signal, nor a temporary obstruction.

en.question: What do these lights in front of a lock mean?
answers: Entry permitted, oncoming traffic prohibited.
Entry permitted, lock gate opening.
Lock in operation, wait for entry signal according to order.
Lock in operation, wait for exit signal according to order.

explanation.de: Zwei grüne Lichter (übereinander) vor einer Schleuse bedeuten: Einfahrt frei, aber der Gegenverkehr (ausfahrende Fahrzeuge) ist gesperrt. Damit wird sichergestellt, dass nur eine Richtung gleichzeitig die Schleuse benutzt. Die anderen Antworten beschreiben andere Signalkombinationen.
explanation.en: Two green lights (displayed vertically) in front of a lock mean: entry is permitted, but oncoming traffic (vessels exiting) is prohibited. This ensures only one direction uses the lock at a time. The other options describe different signal combinations that do not correspond to this light pattern.
explanation.memoryAid: Two greens = Go in, but nobody comes out — one-way green light.

en.question: Which leaflet contains guidance on behaviour for the protection of rare animals and plants and for keeping waterways clean?
answers: The 10 golden rules for water sports enthusiasts.
The 15 golden rules for water sports enthusiasts.
The 10 basic rules for water sports enthusiasts.
The 15 rules of conduct for water sports enthusiasts.

explanation.de: Das offizielle deutsche Merkblatt zum Umweltschutz für Wassersportler trägt den Titel 'Die 10 goldenen Regeln für Wassersportler'. Die anderen Antworten verwenden falsche Zahlen (15) oder falsche Bezeichnungen ('Grundregeln', 'Verhaltensregeln') und sind daher nicht korrekt.
explanation.en: The official German leaflet on environmental protection for recreational boaters is titled 'Die 10 goldenen Regeln für Wassersportler' (The 10 golden rules for water sports enthusiasts). The other options use incorrect numbers (15) or incorrect titles ('Grundregeln', 'Verhaltensregeln'), making them wrong.
explanation.memoryAid: 10 GOLDEN rules — ten fingers, gold standard for green boating.

en.question: How can one help preserve and promote the living conditions of flora and fauna in bodies of water and wetlands?
answers: By acting in an environmentally conscious manner and observing the 'Ten Golden Rules for the Behaviour of Water Sports Enthusiasts in Nature'.
By acting in an environmentally conscious manner and observing the 'Ten Basic Rules for Water Sports'.
By acting prudently and observing the traffic regulations.
By anticipatory navigation and giving way in accordance with the traffic regulations.

explanation.de: Die korrekte Antwort verweist auf die offiziell anerkannten 'Zehn goldenen Regeln für das Verhalten von Wassersportlern in der Natur', die speziell zum Schutz von Gewässern und Feuchtgebieten entwickelt wurden. Die anderen Antworten nennen entweder einen erfundenen Regelkatalog (b) oder beschränken sich auf Verkehrsvorschriften, die keinen direkten Umweltschutzbezug haben (c, d).
explanation.en: The correct answer refers to the officially recognised 'Ten Golden Rules for the Behaviour of Water Sports Enthusiasts in Nature', which were specifically developed to protect aquatic habitats and wetlands. The other options either cite a fictitious ruleset (b) or refer only to traffic regulations, which have no direct environmental protection focus (c, d).
explanation.memoryAid: Golden rules = gold standard for green boating.

en.question: Why should one keep as far away as possible from reed and bulrush zones as well as from densely vegetated shoreline areas?
answers: Because these zones are frequently resting and breeding sites for birds particularly worthy of protection, or fish spawning grounds.
Because in these zones there is a risk of grounding.
Because the plants could block the propeller.
Because swimmers in these zones are difficult to spot.

explanation.de: Schilf- und Röhrichtzonen sind wichtige Lebensräume für schutzwürdige Vogelarten und dienen als Fischlaichplätze. Sportboote sollen diese Zonen aus Gründen des Natur- und Umweltschutzes meiden. Die anderen Antworten beschreiben zwar mögliche praktische Gefahren, sind aber nicht der im Regelwerk genannte Hauptgrund.
explanation.en: Reed beds and densely vegetated shoreline zones serve as critical habitats for protected bird species and as spawning grounds for fish. Boaters are required to avoid these areas primarily for environmental protection reasons. The other options may describe real hazards in some situations, but they are not the primary reason given in the regulations.
explanation.memoryAid: Reeds = Refuge: birds nest and fish spawn there — stay clear for nature's sake.

en.question: Why should a small vessel not approach closely to a large vessel that is underway?
answers: It may capsize due to the vessel's bow or stern wave, or be drawn into collision with it by the suction effect.
Approaching closely is a violation of the basic rules for behaviour in traffic.
Because it would otherwise be unable to give way to the large vessel underway.
It may be struck by heavy seas caused by the vessel's bow or stern wave.

explanation.de: Die Hauptgefahr beim dichten Heranfahren an ein großes Fahrzeug sind die Bugwelle und das Heckwasser sowie der hydrodynamische Sog, der das kleine Fahrzeug in die Seite des großen ziehen kann – beides kann zum Kentern führen. Antwort d beschreibt nur einen Teil der Gefahr (Seeschlag), nennt aber nicht das Kentern durch den Sog. Antworten b und c sind keine sachlich zutreffenden Hauptgründe.
explanation.en: The primary dangers when approaching a large underway vessel closely are the bow and stern waves and the hydrodynamic suction effect, which can pull the small vessel into the side of the larger one — both can cause capsizing. Answer d only partially describes the hazard (heavy spray/seas) but omits the risk of capsizing due to suction. Answers b and c are not the correct primary reasons.
explanation.memoryAid: Big ships make big waves AND big suction — both can flip you.

en.question: Why should you approach a berth heading into the current and wind whenever possible?
answers: Because the vessel can be manoeuvred more safely in this way.
Because this avoids suction effects and wave wash.
Because this compensates for the effects of waves and water depth.
Because this increases the steering effect of the propeller.

explanation.de: Gegen Strom und Wind anzulegen gibt dem Fahrer natürliche Bremskräfte, sodass die Geschwindigkeit schrittweise reduziert und das Fahrzeug präzise gestoppt werden kann. Das Manöver ist wesentlich besser kontrollierbar als bei achterlichem Strom oder Wind, der das Fahrzeug unkontrolliert an den Liegeplatz drücken würde. Antworten b und c beschreiben nicht zutreffende Effekte, und Antwort d verwechselt die Steuerwirkung der Schraube mit dem allgemeinen Manövriervorteil.
explanation.en: Approaching into the current and wind gives the helmsman natural braking forces, allowing speed to be reduced gradually and the vessel to be stopped with precision. This makes the manoeuvre far more controllable than approaching with current or wind from astern, which would push the vessel onto the berth unpredictably. Options b and c describe unrelated effects, and option d confuses propeller steering effect with the broader manoeuvring advantage.
explanation.memoryAid: Into the wind = into control: nature does the braking for you.

en.question: How should you behave when meeting other vessels in a narrow channel?
answers: Reduce speed and maintain sufficient passing distance.
Increase speed in order to carry out the passing manoeuvre swiftly.
The vessel proceeding against the current is required to give way.
The vessel proceeding with the current must stop.

explanation.de: In einem engen Fahrwasser verringert die Geschwindigkeitsreduktion den Sog und Wellenschlag, verbessert die Manövrierfähigkeit und gewährleistet ausreichenden Passierabstand. Eine Erhöhung der Geschwindigkeit (Option b) wäre kontraproduktiv. Die Optionen c und d beschreiben keine allgemein gültigen Begegnungsregeln für enge Fahrwasser.
explanation.en: In a narrow channel, reducing speed minimises wash, improves manoeuvrability, and ensures a safe passing distance between vessels. Increasing speed (option b) would do the opposite. Options c and d describe rules that do not apply as general meeting obligations in narrow channels.

en.question: What dangers can arise when a small vessel is overtaken by a larger one?
answers: The smaller vessel can be pushed off course by bow wave pressure, suction, or swell, causing it to collide or broach, and in shallow waters to run aground.
The larger vessel can be pushed off course by bow wave pressure, suction, or swell, causing it to collide or broach, and in shallow waters to run aground.
The smaller vessel can be pushed off course by bow wave pressure, suction, or swell, causing it to collide or capsize, and in shallow waters to be set extremely off course.
The larger vessel can be pushed off course by wave formation, causing it to collide or broach, and in shallow waters to run aground.

explanation.de: Wenn ein großes Fahrzeug ein kleines überholt, erzeugt es Stau (Druckwelle am Bug), Sog (Unterdruck am Heck) und Schwell (Wellensystem), die das kleinere Fahrzeug destabilisieren können. Das kleinere Fahrzeug ist aufgrund seiner geringen Masse besonders anfällig für diese Kräfte – Kollision, Querschlagen oder Grundberührung in flachem Wasser sind die Folge. Antwort b und d sind falsch, weil das größere Fahrzeug durch diese Effekte kaum beeinflusst wird; Antwort c nennt 'kentern' statt 'querschlagen' und 'extrem versetzt werden' statt 'auf Grund laufen', was die Gefahr ungenau beschreibt.
explanation.en: When a large vessel overtakes a small one, it generates bow pressure (Stau), suction (Sog), and a wake swell (Schwell) that can destabilize the smaller vessel. Because of its low mass, the smaller vessel is highly susceptible to these forces — risking collision, broaching, or grounding in shallow water. Options b and d are incorrect because the larger vessel is barely affected by these hydrodynamic effects; option c inaccurately substitutes 'capsize' for 'broach' and 'set off course' for 'run aground'.
explanation.memoryAid: Small boat, big wake: pressure pushes, suction pulls, swell rolls — all spell danger for the overtaken vessel.

en.question: Where can you find information about environmentally friendly paints, varnishes, and antifouling coatings for your boat?
answers: At the Federal Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt).
At the Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport Affairs (Bundesministerium für Digitales und Verkehr).
In the Recreational Craft Licence Regulation (Sportbootführerscheinverordnung).
In the Recreational Craft Rental Regulation (Sportbootvermietungsverordnung).

explanation.de: Das Umweltbundesamt (UBA) ist die zuständige deutsche Behörde für Umweltschutzfragen und veröffentlicht Informationen und Empfehlungen zu umweltverträglichen Produkten wie Farben und Antifouling-Beschichtungen. Die anderen Optionen befassen sich mit Verkehrsrecht bzw. Bootsvermietung und enthalten keine derartigen Produktinformationen.
explanation.en: The Federal Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt, UBA) is Germany's competent authority for environmental protection matters and publishes guidance on environmentally compatible products such as paints and antifouling coatings. The other options deal with transport law or boat rental regulations and do not contain such product information.
explanation.memoryAid: UBA = Umwelt-Bundes-Amt → the 'Umwelt' (environment) agency is the go-to for eco-friendly boat coatings.

en.question: How can you tell whether the anchor is holding?
answers: When placing your hand on the anchor chain or line, no jerking can be felt, and the anchor bearing does not change.
When the anchor chain or line does not vibrate and the current magnetic compass course does not change.
When placing your hand on the anchor chain or line, no jerking can be felt, and the vessel is not swinging.
When placing your hand on the anchor chain or line, no jerking can be felt, and the anchor bearing changes.

explanation.de: Ein haltender Anker zeigt sich daran, dass keine Rucke in der Kette/Leine zu spüren sind (kein Schleppen über Grund) und die Peilung zum Anker konstant bleibt. Option d ist falsch, weil eine sich ändernde Ankerpeilung gerade anzeigt, dass das Fahrzeug treibt. Option c ist falsch, weil ein gewisses Schwoj (Pendeln um den Anker) beim Ankern normal ist und kein Zeichen für schlechtes Halten.
explanation.en: A holding anchor is confirmed by the absence of jerking in the chain or line (indicating it is not dragging along the seabed) and a steady, unchanging bearing to the anchor. Option d is wrong because a changing anchor bearing indicates the vessel is dragging. Option c is wrong because some swinging (yawing around the anchor) is normal at anchor and does not indicate poor holding.
explanation.memoryAid: No jerk + steady bearing = anchor's not veering.

en.question: What is the most favourable approach angle when coming alongside?
answers: As shallow an angle as possible.
An angle of 90° to 100°.
As wide an angle as possible.
An angle of 60° to 70°.

explanation.de: Ein möglichst spitzer (flacher) Winkel beim Anlegen ermöglicht eine kontrollierte, sanfte Annäherung an den Steg oder die Pier, da das Schiff fast parallel zum Liegeplatz geführt wird und die Restgeschwindigkeit leichter abgebaut werden kann. Ein steiler Winkel (z. B. 90°) würde das Schiff unkontrolliert gegen die Pier treiben lassen.
explanation.en: A shallow approach angle allows a controlled, gentle approach to the berth, as the vessel is guided nearly parallel to the dock and forward momentum can be dissipated gradually. A steep angle (e.g. 90°) would drive the bow directly into the dock with little opportunity to correct or slow down.
explanation.memoryAid: Think 'graze, don't crash' — come in flat and slide gently alongside.

en.question: How does a vessel with a right-handed propeller generally behave when going astern?
answers: The stern swings to port.
The stern swings to starboard.
The vessel's heading does not change.
The bow swings to port.

explanation.de: Ein rechtsdrehender Propeller (im Vorwärtsgang im Uhrzeigersinn, von achtern gesehen) dreht sich im Rückwärtsgang gegen den Uhrzeigersinn. Der sogenannte Radeffekt (Querkraft) drückt dabei das Heck nach Backbord. Option b ist falsch, weil der Radeffekt beim Rückwärtsgang eines rechtsdrehenden Propellers gerade in die entgegengesetzte Richtung wirkt.
explanation.en: A right-handed propeller (clockwise in forward gear, viewed from astern) rotates counter-clockwise when reversed. The resulting paddle-wheel effect (transverse thrust) pushes the stern to port. Option b is incorrect because the transverse thrust acts in the opposite direction when a right-handed propeller is put astern.
explanation.memoryAid: Right-handed astern = stern goes Left (port) — 'R goes reverse-Left'.

en.question: What does the kill switch (Quickstopp) do?
answers: Interrupts the ignition circuit or fuel supply.
Automatically starts the engine.
Briefly interrupts engine operation.
Automatically reverses thrust.

explanation.de: Der Quickstopp (Notausschalter) unterbricht sofort den Zündkontakt oder die Kraftstoffzufuhr und stoppt damit den Motor dauerhaft. Dies ist eine Sicherheitseinrichtung, die z. B. über eine Reißleine am Fahrer ausgelöst wird, wenn dieser über Bord geht. Eine bloß kurze Unterbrechung (Antwort c) wäre kein zuverlässiger Notstopp.
explanation.en: The kill switch (Quickstopp) immediately cuts the ignition circuit or fuel supply, bringing the engine to a complete stop. It is a safety device typically connected to the helm operator via a lanyard, so the engine stops if the operator falls overboard. A mere brief interruption (option c) would not constitute a reliable emergency stop.
explanation.memoryAid: Kill switch = kills the ignition — permanently, not temporarily.

en.question: What should be done if fuel or oil gets into the bilge?
answers: Absorb it with rags and dispose of them in an environmentally proper manner.
Ventilate the spaces and wait.
Distribute it evenly.
Neutralise it with an appropriate agent.

explanation.de: Kraftstoff oder Öl in der Bilge muss mechanisch mit Lappen oder Ölbindemitteln aufgenommen und anschließend als Sondermüll umweltgerecht entsorgt werden. Das Einleiten von öligem Bilgenwasser ins Gewässer ist verboten. Die anderen Optionen – verteilen, abwarten oder chemisch neutralisieren – beseitigen den Schadstoff nicht ordnungsgemäß und können die Umwelt zusätzlich belasten.
explanation.en: Fuel or oil in the bilge must be absorbed mechanically using rags or oil-absorbent materials and then disposed of as hazardous waste in an environmentally responsible way. Pumping oily bilge water overboard is prohibited. The other options – distributing it, waiting, or chemically neutralising it – do not properly remove the pollutant and can cause further environmental harm.
explanation.memoryAid: Soak it, bag it, bin it — never pump it overboard.

en.question: What is meant by a right-handed propeller?
answers: Viewed from astern, the propeller rotates clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from forward, the propeller rotates clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from astern, the propeller rotates counter-clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from forward, the propeller rotates counter-clockwise when going astern.

explanation.de: Ein rechtsdrehender Propeller dreht sich in Vorausfahrt, von achtern betrachtet, im Uhrzeigersinn. Der Betrachtungspunkt ist stets von achtern. Gegen den Uhrzeigersinn von achtern (Antwort c) wäre ein linksdrehender Propeller; die Antworten b und d verwenden den falschen Betrachtungspunkt (von vorne).
explanation.en: A right-handed propeller is defined by its direction of rotation as seen from astern (behind the vessel) while driving ahead — it turns clockwise. This is the standard reference point for propeller handedness. Viewing from the front (answers b and d) is the wrong reference direction, and counter-clockwise rotation from astern (answer c) would describe a left-handed propeller.
explanation.memoryAid: Right-handed = clockwise from astern — just like a normal screw tightening as you push it away from you.

en.question: What is meant by a left-handed propeller?
answers: Viewed from astern, the propeller rotates counter-clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from forward, the propeller rotates counter-clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from astern, the propeller rotates clockwise when going ahead.
Viewed from forward, the propeller rotates clockwise when going astern.

explanation.de: Ein linksdrehender Propeller dreht sich – von achtern betrachtet – in Vorausfahrt gegen den Uhrzeigersinn. Die Drehrichtung eines Propellers wird stets von achtern (aus Fahrtrichtung gesehen von hinten) beurteilt. Option c beschreibt dagegen einen rechtsdrehenden Propeller.
explanation.en: A left-handed propeller rotates counter-clockwise when viewed from astern while the vessel is going ahead. Propeller rotation is always defined from the astern perspective. Option c describes a right-handed (clockwise) propeller, which is the opposite.
explanation.memoryAid: Left-handed = counter-clockwise from astern — like a left-hand thread on a bolt.

en.question: What is meant by the indirect rudder effect (paddle-wheel effect) of the propeller?
answers: The lateral displacement of the stern.
The forward displacement.
The rearward displacement.
The lateral displacement of the bow.

explanation.de: Der Radeffekt beschreibt, wie ein drehender Propeller wie ein Schaufelrad wirkt und das Heck seitlich versetzt — bei einem rechtsdrehenden Propeller im Rückwärtsgang typischerweise nach Backbord. Es handelt sich um eine Querkraft am Heck, keine Längsbewegung (b, c falsch). Der Bug bewegt sich nur indirekt als Folge der Heckbewegung (d falsch).
explanation.en: The paddle-wheel effect (Radeffekt) describes how a rotating propeller acts like a paddle wheel, pushing the stern sideways — typically to port when going astern with a right-handed propeller. This is a transverse (lateral) force on the stern, not a longitudinal movement, which rules out answers b and c. The bow is indirectly affected only as a consequence of stern movement, so answer d is also incorrect.
explanation.memoryAid: The propeller 'paddles' the stern sideways — think of a paddle wheel pushing the back of the boat to the side.

en.question: Why is knowledge of the propeller's direction of rotation important?
answers: It assists with manoeuvring.
It assists with maintaining course.
It assists with overtaking.
It assists with meeting other vessels.

explanation.de: Die Drehrichtung des Propellers erzeugt einen Drehmomenteffekt (Propellerquerkraft), der das Heck des Bootes seitlich versetzt – besonders beim Anfahren und beim Rückwärtsfahren. Dieses Wissen ist entscheidend beim Manövrieren, etwa beim Anlegen oder Ablegen. Kurshalten, Überholen und Begegnen werden durch die Propellerdrehrichtung nicht wesentlich beeinflusst.
explanation.en: The direction of propeller rotation creates a transverse thrust effect (propeller walk) that kicks the stern sideways – especially when engaging ahead or astern. This is critical knowledge when manoeuvring, such as when docking or undocking. Maintaining course, overtaking, and meeting other vessels are not significantly affected by propeller rotation direction.
explanation.memoryAid: Propeller 'walks' the stern sideways → matters most when manoeuvring at slow speed.

en.question: Which side is recommended for coming alongside with a right-handed propeller, and why?
answers: Port side – the paddlewheel effect pulls the stern towards the pier.
Starboard side – the paddlewheel effect pulls the stern towards the pier.
Either starboard or port side, depending on rudder position.
There is no recommended side.

explanation.de: Ein rechtsdrehender Propeller (im Vorwärtsgang im Uhrzeigersinn von achtern gesehen) erzeugt beim Rückwärtsfahren einen Radeffekt, der das Heck nach Backbord zieht. Legt man backbordseitig an, wird das Fahrzeug dadurch an die Pier gezogen, was das Anlegen erleichtert. Bei steuerbordsseitigem Anlegen würde das Heck vom Steg weggedrückt.
explanation.en: A right-handed propeller (clockwise rotation when viewed from astern in ahead) produces a paddlewheel/transverse thrust effect in reverse that kicks the stern to port. By mooring port-side-to, this effect pulls the stern toward the pier, making the final approach easier and safer. Mooring starboard-side-to would cause the stern to swing away from the pier in reverse.
explanation.memoryAid: Right-hand prop in reverse: stern goes LEFT → moor PORT side to the pier.

en.question: What must be observed when refuelling?
answers: Switch off the engine, do not operate any electrical switches, take precautions against fuel overflow, no open flames.
Engine at idle, do not operate any electrical switches, take precautions against fuel overflow, no open flames.
Close windows, do not operate any electrical switches, take precautions against fuel overflow, no open flames.
Switch off the engine, keep a fire extinguisher ready, take precautions against fuel overflow, no open flames.

explanation.de: Beim Tanken muss der Motor vollständig abgestellt werden – Leerlauf (Antwort b) reicht nicht aus, da der Motor weiterhin Zündquellen erzeugt. Elektrische Schalter dürfen nicht betätigt werden, da Funken entstehen können. Zwar ist ein Feuerlöscher grundsätzlich empfehlenswert, er ersetzt jedoch nicht die Pflicht, den Motor abzustellen (Antwort d ist daher unvollständig). Das Schließen von Fenstern (Antwort c) ist keine Hauptmaßnahme beim Tanken.
explanation.en: When refuelling, the engine must be fully switched off — idle (answer b) is insufficient because the engine still produces ignition sources. Electrical switches must not be operated as they can produce sparks. While a fire extinguisher is generally advisable, it does not replace the requirement to switch off the engine (making answer d incomplete). Closing windows (answer c) is not a primary refuelling safety measure.
explanation.memoryAid: SNAP: Switch off engine, No electrical switches, Anti-overflow measures, no open flames (No fire).

en.question: How is the steering effect achieved on a vessel with an outboard motor and no rudder?
answers: By the propeller wash and the direction of the propeller.
By the propeller wash and the pitch angle of the propeller.
By the propeller resistance and the pitch angle of the propeller.
By the propeller resistance and the direction of the propeller.

explanation.de: Ein Außenbordmotor besitzt kein separates Ruder; stattdessen schwenkt die gesamte Motoreinheit, wodurch die Richtung des Propellers verändert wird. Der Schraubenstrom (Schubstrahl) wirkt in der neuen Richtung gegen das Wasser und erzeugt so die Ruderwirkung. 'Schraubenwiderstand' und 'Anstellwinkel' sind Ablenkungsoptionen, die für fest eingebaute Antriebe gelten, nicht für Außenborder.
explanation.en: An outboard motor has no separate rudder; instead, the entire motor unit pivots, changing the direction the propeller faces. The propeller wash (thrust stream) acts against the water in that new direction, producing the steering force. Propeller 'resistance' and 'pitch angle' are distractors referring to fixed-propeller concepts that do not apply to outboard steering.
explanation.memoryAid: Outboard = point and shoot: the propeller wash pushes the stern in whichever direction the motor points.

en.question: Why does rudder effectiveness set in relatively late when a vessel with an inboard engine and fixed shaft begins to move astern?
answers: Because it only takes effect once water flow over the rudder blade is established.
Because the paddle-wheel effect creates a low-pressure zone at the propeller.
Due to the distance between the propeller and the rudder blade.
Because the paddle-wheel effect creates a low-pressure zone at the rudder.

explanation.de: Das Ruder wirkt nur, wenn Wasser gegen das Ruderblatt strömt (Anströmung). Bei Rückwärtsfahrt muss das Schiff erst eine gewisse Rückwärtsgeschwindigkeit aufgebaut haben, bevor ausreichend Wasserströmung am Ruderblatt entsteht. Der Radeffekt (Propellerseitenkraft) ist ein separates Phänomen und hat nichts mit dem späten Einsetzen der Ruderwirkung zu tun.
explanation.en: The rudder only generates a steering force when water flows across the rudder blade. When going astern, the vessel must first build up sufficient sternward speed before there is enough water flow over the blade to produce rudder effect. The paddle-wheel effect (propeller transverse thrust) is a separate phenomenon and is not the reason for the delayed rudder response.
explanation.memoryAid: No flow, no go — the rudder needs water moving past it to steer.

en.question: While underway, the engine installation should be continuously monitored. What must be paid particular attention to?
answers: Engine temperature, oil pressure, charge control (battery charging indicator).
Cooling water outlet, tachometer, V-belt tension.
Propeller shaft speed, gearbox oil temperature, oil pressure.
Injection pump pressure, impeller pump, oil pump.

explanation.de: Die drei wichtigsten Überwachungsgrößen während der Fahrt sind Motortemperatur (Überhitzung erkennen), Öldruck (Schmiermittelversagen erkennen) und Ladekontrolle (sicherstellen, dass die Lichtmaschine die Batterie lädt). Die Distraktoren enthalten Punkte, die eher bei der Wartung geprüft werden (Keilriemenspannung, Einspritzpumpendruck) und keine kontinuierliche Überwachungsaufgabe darstellen.
explanation.en: The three primary indicators for safe engine operation while underway are engine temperature (to detect overheating), oil pressure (to detect lubrication failure), and the charging indicator (to ensure the alternator is keeping the battery charged). The distractors mix in items that are either checked during maintenance rather than continuous monitoring (V-belt tension, injection pump pressure) or are less critical as continuous watch items.
explanation.memoryAid: T-O-C: Temperature, Oil pressure, Charge — the three dials to watch while at the helm.

en.question: The temperature of the propulsion engine exceeds the permissible limits. What could be the possible cause?
answers: Defective thermostat, defective impeller pump, closed sea cock, coolant level too low.
Too much engine oil, defective impeller pump, closed sea cock, coolant level too low.
Defective thermostat, defective impeller pump, closed sea cock, battery voltage too high.
Defective thermostat, defective clutch, closed sea cock, coolant level too low.

explanation.de: Alle vier genannten Faktoren in Antwort (a) sind klassische Ursachen für Überhitzung: Ein defektes Thermostat verhindert die Kühlwasserregulierung, eine defekte Impellerpumpe unterbricht den Kühlwasserkreislauf, ein geschlossenes Seeventil stoppt die Wasserzufuhr, und zu niedriger Kühlwasserstand reduziert die Kühlkapazität. Die anderen Antworten enthalten Faktoren (zu viel Motoröl, zu hohe Batteriespannung, defekte Kupplung), die keine direkte Wirkung auf die Motortemperatur haben.
explanation.en: All four factors in answer (a) are classic causes of engine overheating: a defective thermostat prevents coolant regulation, a defective impeller pump disrupts coolant circulation, a closed sea cock stops the water supply, and a coolant level that is too low reduces cooling capacity. The other answers include factors (too much engine oil, battery voltage too high, defective clutch) that have no direct effect on engine temperature.
explanation.memoryAid: The 4 C's of cooling failure: Circulation (impeller), Control (thermostat), Cutoff (sea cock), Capacity (coolant level).

en.question: The charging warning light does not go out after starting. What could be the possible cause?
answers: Alternator or alternator regulator is defective.
Engine speed is too high.
Drive belt has snapped and there is high power consumption.
The starter motor has failed after starting.

explanation.de: Die Ladekontrolllampe leuchtet, wenn die Lichtmaschine keinen Strom in die Batterie einspeist — am häufigsten wegen eines Defekts an der Lichtmaschine oder ihrem Spannungsregler. Ein gerissener Keilriemen (Option c) würde ebenfalls das Laden verhindern, ist aber als Kombination mit 'hohem Stromverbrauch' nicht die typische Einzelursache. Zu hohe Drehzahl oder ein ausgefallener Anlasser beeinflussen den Ladekreis nicht.
explanation.en: The charging warning light stays on when the alternator is not supplying current to the battery — most commonly because the alternator itself or its voltage regulator is faulty. A snapped drive belt (option c) would also prevent charging, but if the belt were broken you would typically also lose coolant circulation and see other warning signs; more importantly, high power consumption alone does not keep the charge light on. Options b and d are unrelated to the charging circuit.
explanation.memoryAid: No charge light off = alternator not working — check the generator first.

en.question: The oil warning light stays on after starting the engine. What could be the possible cause?
answers: Pressure switch or oil pressure pump defective.
Too much engine oil in the engine.
RCD (residual current device) defective.
Engine speed too high.

explanation.de: Wenn die Ölkontrollleuchte nach dem Starten weiter leuchtet, deutet dies auf zu geringen Öldruck hin — am wahrscheinlichsten verursacht durch einen defekten Druckschalter oder eine defekte Öldruckpumpe. Zu viel Öl würde keinen Niederdruck auslösen, und Motordrehzahl sowie FI-Schalter haben keinen Bezug zur Öldruckwarnung.
explanation.en: If the oil warning light remains on after starting, it indicates insufficient oil pressure — most likely caused by a faulty oil pressure switch or a defective oil pressure pump. Too much oil would not trigger a low-pressure warning, and engine speed and the RCD are unrelated to the oil pressure warning light.
explanation.memoryAid: Light stays on = pressure is gone — check the switch or the pump.

en.question: The engine has been started. What could be the cause if the engine stops after engaging the drive shaft?
answers: Blocked propeller.
Blocked fuel supply.
Dirty oil filter.
Dirty air filter.

explanation.de: Wenn der Motor läuft, aber nach dem Einkuppeln sofort abwürgt, deutet das auf einen mechanischen Widerstand in der Antriebslinie hin – typischerweise ein blockierter Propeller (z. B. durch ein Seil oder Treibgut). Eine blockierte Kraftstoffzufuhr, ein verschmutzter Öl- oder Luftfilter würden verhindern, dass der Motor überhaupt läuft oder ihn unabhängig vom Einkuppeln zum Stillstand bringen.
explanation.en: If the engine runs but stalls immediately upon engaging the drive shaft, this points to mechanical resistance in the drivetrain — typically a blocked propeller (e.g. fouled by a rope or debris). A blocked fuel supply or dirty oil/air filter would prevent the engine from running in the first place, or would cause it to stop regardless of whether the shaft is engaged.
explanation.memoryAid: Engine runs, then stalls on engagement = something is jamming the propeller.

en.question: An outboard motor with a full tank stops while underway. What could be the causes?
answers: Vent screw closed; clogged fuel line.
Intake jets too large or too small.
Tank cap is open.
Propeller loose on the shaft.

explanation.de: Wenn die Belüftungsschraube am Tank geschlossen ist, entsteht ein Unterdruck, der den Kraftstofffluss unterbricht. Eine verstopfte Kraftstoffleitung verhindert ebenfalls die Kraftstoffzufuhr zum Motor. Ein offener Tankdeckel wäre kein Problem, und eine lose Schraube würde keinen Motorstillstand, sondern einen Antriebsverlust verursachen.
explanation.en: If the tank's vent screw is closed, a vacuum builds up that cuts off fuel flow. A clogged fuel line also prevents fuel from reaching the engine. An open tank cap would not cause a stoppage, and a loose propeller would result in loss of thrust rather than the engine stopping.
explanation.memoryAid: No vent = no flow: a closed vent or blocked line starves the engine of fuel.

en.question: Which publications contain important rules and tips for water sports enthusiasts, recommendations on the equipment of recreational boats, and guidance on environmentally responsible behaviour on the water?
answers: Nautical publications such as 'Sicherheit auf dem Wasser' (Safety on the Water) and 'Sicher auf See' (Safe at Sea).
The Regulation on the Safety of Navigation (Verordnung über die Sicherung der Seefahrt) and nautical publications such as 'Sicher auf See' (Safe at Sea).
The nautical publication 'Sicherheit auf dem Wasser' (Safety on the Water) and the International Code of Signals.
The International Code of Signals and the Regulation on the Safety of Navigation (Verordnung über die Sicherung der Seefahrt).

explanation.de: Die Publikationen 'Sicherheit auf dem Wasser' (herausgegeben von der DLRG/DSV u. a.) und 'Sicher auf See' (BSH) richten sich speziell an Wassersportler und enthalten Ausrüstungsempfehlungen, Sicherheitstipps und Umwelthinweise. Die 'Verordnung über die Sicherung der Seefahrt' ist ein formales Regelwerk ohne praktische Ausrüstungstipps, und das Internationale Signalbuch behandelt ausschließlich Kommunikationssignale.
explanation.en: The publications 'Sicherheit auf dem Wasser' (issued by organisations such as DLRG/DSV) and 'Sicher auf See' (published by the BSH) are specifically aimed at recreational boaters and cover equipment recommendations, safety tips, and environmental guidance. The 'Verordnung über die Sicherung der Seefahrt' is a formal regulatory instrument without practical equipment advice, and the International Code of Signals deals solely with communication signals.
explanation.memoryAid: Two friendly guides for boaters: 'Safety ON the Water' + 'Safe AT Sea' — both are for YOU, not for lawyers or signal officers.

en.question: Under what conditions may a sports boat with an electric motor be operated without a licence?
answers: The propulsion power is at most 7.5 kilowatts in duty cycle S1 (continuous operation).
It may always be operated without a licence, regardless of the propulsion power.
Up to a propulsion power of 11.03 kilowatts in duty cycle S1 (continuous operation).
It may never be operated without a licence, regardless of the propulsion power.

explanation.de: Für Sportboote mit Elektromotor gilt die gleiche Leistungsgrenze wie für Verbrennungsmotoren: bis zu 7,5 kW im Dauerbetrieb (S1) ist keine Fahrerlaubnis erforderlich. Der Betriebsart S1 entspricht dem kontinuierlichen Betrieb ohne Leistungsunterbrechung. Die Antwort c (11,03 kW) ist falsch – dieser Wert entspricht etwa 15 PS und ist nicht die maßgebliche Grenze.
explanation.en: For sports boats with an electric motor, the same power threshold applies as for combustion engines: up to 7.5 kW in continuous-duty mode (S1), no licence is required. Duty cycle S1 denotes uninterrupted continuous operation. Answer c (11.03 kW) is incorrect – that value corresponds to approximately 15 hp and is not the relevant legal threshold.
explanation.memoryAid: 7.5 kW = licence-free, whether electric or not.

en.question: What precautions must be taken when leaving the vessel unattended for an extended period?
answers: Close all seacocks and switch off the main electrical switch.
Top up the fuel and water tanks and charge the on-board electrical system.
Close the day tank and drain the fuel filter.
Leave the vessel in a seaworthy condition and notify the harbourmaster.

explanation.de: Beim längeren Verlassen des Fahrzeugs müssen alle Seeventile geschlossen werden, um ein Eindringen von Wasser durch Rumpfdurchführungen zu verhindern, und der Hauptschalter des Bordnetzes muss ausgeschaltet werden, um Brandgefahr durch elektrische Fehler zu vermeiden. Das Benachrichtigen des Hafenmeisters oder das Auffüllen von Tanks beseitigt diese unmittelbaren Risiken nicht.
explanation.en: When leaving a vessel unattended for an extended period, the priority safety measure is to close all seacocks (to prevent flooding through open hull fittings) and switch off the main electrical switch (to eliminate the risk of fire from electrical faults). Simply notifying the harbourmaster or topping up tanks does not address the immediate risks of flooding or electrical fire.
explanation.memoryAid: Seacocks shut, switch off — sea stays out, sparks stay dead.

en.question: How must a narrow waterway be navigated when approaching vessels moored at the bank?
answers: Reduce speed to avoid harmful suction and wash.
Maintain speed so that planing eliminates harmful suction and wash.
Reduce speed and, if necessary, deviate from the keep-right rule.
Come to a stop abreast of the moored vessels and verify that no third party is obstructed or harmed.

explanation.de: In engen Gewässern muss die Geschwindigkeit beim Passieren festgemachter Fahrzeuge reduziert werden, damit Sog und Wellenschlag keinen Schaden verursachen. Höhere Geschwindigkeit oder gar Gleitfahrt würde den Sog und Wellenschlag verstärken, nicht verringern. Ein völliges Aufstoppen ist nicht vorgeschrieben und wäre unpraktisch.
explanation.en: In narrow waterways, speed must be reduced when passing moored vessels so that suction and wash do not cause damage. Higher speed or planing would increase — not reduce — suction and wash. Coming to a complete stop is not required and would be impractical.
explanation.memoryAid: Slow down near tied-up boats: your wake is their problem.

en.question: Where should the gas cylinders of a liquefied gas (LPG) system be stored?
answers: Preferably on deck, protected from direct sunlight; otherwise in a specially enclosed compartment for gas cylinders that has an opening to the outside at floor level.
Preferably as low as possible in the vessel, protected from direct sunlight; otherwise in a specially enclosed compartment for gas cylinders that has an opening to the outside at floor level.
Preferably on the foredeck, protected from direct sunlight; otherwise in a specially enclosed compartment for gas cylinders that has an opening to the outside at floor level.
Preferably on deck, protected from direct sunlight; otherwise in a specially enclosed compartment for gas cylinders that is ventilated at the top.

explanation.de: LPG (Flüssiggas) ist schwerer als Luft und sinkt bei einem Leck nach unten. Daher müssen Gasbehälter entweder an Deck gelagert werden, damit ausströmendes Gas ins Freie entweichen kann, oder in einem abgeschlossenen Raum mit einer Bodenöffnung nach außenbords, durch die das schwerere Gas ablaufen kann. Eine Belüftung oben (Antwort d) wäre wirkungslos, da das Gas sich am Boden sammelt.
explanation.en: LPG is heavier than air and sinks to the lowest point if it leaks. Gas cylinders must therefore be stored on deck (where escaping gas disperses overboard) or in a sealed locker with an opening at floor level leading outboard, so that any leaked gas drains away safely. A top ventilation opening (answer d) would be ineffective because the heavy gas accumulates at floor level.
explanation.memoryAid: Heavy gas sinks — so the escape route must be at the BOTTOM, leading overboard.

en.question: Why are the liquefied gases propane and butane particularly dangerous on board?
answers: Both gases are heavier than air and form an explosive mixture with air.
Both gases are lighter than air and form an explosive mixture with air.
Both gases are heavier than water and form an explosive mixture with water.
Both gases are heavier than air and form an explosive mixture with water.

explanation.de: Propan und Butan sind beide schwerer als Luft und sammeln sich daher im tiefsten Punkt des Bootes (Bilge, Bodenwanne) an, wo sie mit Luft ein explosives Gemisch bilden. Schon ein einzelner Funke kann das angesammelte Gas entzünden. Antwort b ist falsch, weil beide Gase schwerer — nicht leichter — als Luft sind; Antworten c und d sind falsch, weil die explosive Reaktion mit Luft und nicht mit Wasser entsteht.
explanation.en: Propane and butane are both heavier than air, so any leaking gas sinks and accumulates in the lowest points of the vessel (bilge, cabin sole), where it can form an explosive mixture with air. This makes it extremely dangerous, as a single spark can ignite the accumulated gas. Distractors b is wrong because both gases are heavier — not lighter — than air; distractors c and d are wrong because the explosive reaction is with air, not water.
explanation.memoryAid: Heavy gas sinks low — propane and butane pool in the bilge like an invisible bomb.

en.question: What must be done if liquefied gas (LPG) enters the interior of the boat?
answers: Shut off the gas supply and ensure ventilation. In addition, do not operate any electrical switches and do not use radio or mobile phones.
Empty the gas line and ensure ventilation. In addition, do not operate any electrical switches and do not use any phones.
Shut off the gas supply and ensure ventilation. In addition, do not operate any electrical switches and call for help by phone.
Empty the gas line and check for gas-free conditions with a lighter, and request help via radio or mobile phone.

explanation.de: Bei einem Gasaustritt muss zuerst die Gaszufuhr am Flaschenventil abgesperrt werden, dann ist für ausreichende Lüftung zu sorgen. Elektrische Schalter, Funk und Mobiltelefone können Funken erzeugen und das explosive Gasgemisch entzünden – daher sind alle diese Geräte zu meiden. Option c ist falsch, weil das Telefonieren einen Zündfunken riskiert; Option d ist besonders gefährlich, weil ein Feuerzeug das Gas sofort entzünden würde.
explanation.en: If gas escapes, the first step is to shut off the gas supply at the cylinder valve, then ventilate thoroughly. Electrical switches, radios, and mobile phones can produce sparks that ignite the explosive gas mixture — all must be avoided. Option c is wrong because using a phone risks ignition; option d is especially dangerous because using a lighter could immediately ignite the gas.
explanation.memoryAid: Gas leak: SHUT, VENT, NO SPARKS — no switches, no radio, no phone, no flames.

en.question: What must be checked before commissioning a liquefied gas (LPG) installation?
answers: The installation must have been approved, lines and connections must be leak-tight. The main valve and other shut-off valves must be opened.
The installation must have been approved; commissioning may only be carried out by a specially qualified person.
The installation must have been approved and inspected annually. Commissioning may only be carried out by a specially qualified person.
The approval of the installation must not be more than three years old. The main valve and other shut-off valves must be opened.

explanation.de: Vor der Inbetriebnahme einer Flüssiggasanlage muss die Anlage offiziell abgenommen worden sein, und es ist sicherzustellen, dass alle Leitungen und Anschlüsse dicht sind. Erst dann dürfen der Haupthahn und die übrigen Absperrventile geöffnet werden. Eine gesonderte Qualifikation für die Inbetriebnahme oder eine jährliche Prüfpflicht ist nicht vorgeschrieben; ebenso gibt es keine Drei-Jahres-Frist für die Abnahme.
explanation.en: Before commissioning an LPG installation, it must have received official approval, and all lines and connections must be verified as leak-tight. Only then may the main valve and other shut-off valves be opened. No special qualification for the operator is required, there is no mandatory annual inspection, and there is no three-year validity limit on the approval — making the other options incorrect.
explanation.memoryAid: Approved + leak-tight → then open the valves. In that order, no exceptions.

en.question: What must be observed when a liquefied gas system is taken out of service?
answers: The main valve and shut-off valves must be closed.
The system must be made gas-free.
Dispose of the gas cylinder properly.
The liquefied gas container must be completely emptied.

explanation.de: Wenn eine Flüssiggasanlage außer Betrieb gesetzt wird, genügt es, den Haupthahn sowie alle Absperrventile zu schließen. Die Anlage muss nicht gasfrei gemacht oder die Flasche entleert werden – das wäre unpraktisch und unnötig. Eine fachgerechte Entsorgung ist nur erforderlich, wenn die Flasche endgültig außer Betrieb genommen wird.
explanation.en: When taking a liquefied gas system out of service, it is sufficient to close the main valve and all shut-off valves. The system does not need to be purged of gas or the cylinder emptied — that would be unnecessary and impractical. Proper disposal of the cylinder is only required if it is being permanently decommissioned.
explanation.memoryAid: Out of service = valves shut — nothing more, nothing less.

en.question: How often must inflatable life-saving appliances be serviced?
answers: In accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, at least every 2 years.
Annually and after every use or practice deployment.
In accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, at least every 3 years.
Annually, before the start of the water sports season each time.

explanation.de: Aufblasbare Rettungsmittel (z. B. aufblasbare Rettungswesten und Rettungsinseln) müssen gemäß den Herstellerangaben gewartet werden, jedoch mindestens alle 2 Jahre. Option B ist falsch, da das vorgeschriebene Mindestintervall 2 Jahre beträgt, nicht zwingend jährlich; Option C ist falsch, da 3 Jahre das zulässige Höchstintervall überschreitet.
explanation.en: Inflatable life-saving appliances (such as inflatable life jackets and life rafts) must be serviced according to the manufacturer's specifications, but in any case at least every 2 years. Option B is incorrect because the minimum mandatory interval is every 2 years, not necessarily annually; option C is wrong because 3 years exceeds the required maximum interval.
explanation.memoryAid: 2 years max — inflate your schedule before it deflates your safety.

en.question: Which fire extinguisher is suitable for recreational boats, and how often must a fire extinguisher be inspected?
answers: ABC dry powder and foam extinguishers, at least every 2 years.
Foam extinguishers, at least once per year.
CO₂ extinguishers, at least every 2 years.
ABC dry powder extinguishers, at least once per year.

explanation.de: Für Sportboote sind ABC-Pulver- und Schaumlöscher am besten geeignet, da sie für alle gängigen Brandklassen (feste Stoffe, flüssige Stoffe, Gase) wirksam sind, die auf einem Boot auftreten können. Die vorgeschriebene Prüfintervall beträgt mindestens alle 2 Jahre. CO₂-Löscher sind in engen Bootsräumen wegen Erstickungsgefahr problematisch; reine Schaumlöscher oder Pulverlöscher allein decken nicht alle Brandklassen optimal ab.
explanation.en: ABC dry powder and foam extinguishers are most suitable for recreational boats because they are effective against all common fire classes (solids, liquids, gases) likely to occur on board. The required inspection interval is at least every 2 years. CO₂ extinguishers pose an asphyxiation risk in confined boat spaces, and using only foam or only powder extinguishers does not optimally cover all fire classes.
explanation.memoryAid: ABC covers All Boat Classes of fire — check it every 2 years.

en.question: What measures must be taken to effectively fight a fire with a fire extinguisher?
answers: Prevent air supply, deploy the fire extinguisher only at the seat of the fire, and fight the fire from below as much as possible.
Ensure smoke extraction and deploy the fire extinguisher in time, keeping the extinguishing jet directed into the open flames as much as possible.
